hypothesis: A spatially pooled, stable ridge-AR(2) forecast fit from the current measured 20-frame input and blended at weight 0.25 into the dual-head FNO fluctuation before emaV will improve coherent fluctuation alignment on a newly trained complement-fold model, raising Rel-L2 and the five-component mean while preserving E029's TKE, mean, uncertainty, and runtime strengths.
comparator: The same independently trained complement-fold dual-head checkpoint with mean-bias EMA, emaV, and frozen (0.02, 0.14) bounds but no pooled dynamics donor.

data.normalization: official mean_std_real.pt; evaluator-aligned, not recomputed on the train split

training.checkpoint_selection: fixed final update; no validation-based early stopping

selection_provenance.order: fixed from the smallest shared oscillator model
selection_provenance.ridge_blend: fixed from E023 train-side cal/audit exploratory replay
selection_provenance.v1_status: already viewed; diagnostic only and prohibited for E030 selection
selection_provenance.complement_status: untouched for a model trained on the complement manifest

initialization_audit.finding: The historical E020/E021 trainer passed fp16 wrapper dictionaries directly to the dual-head initializer and silently left the model randomly initialized.
initialization_audit.e030_policy: Unpack the official sim-pretrained fp16 state, require exact key coverage, and verify identity initialization before training. Baseline and pooled-AR candidate share this checkpoint, preserving the mechanism comparison.
